name: Live Activities
description: Your iPhone's Live Activities on the Car Thing, mirrored from your Mac and redrawn natively. Needs a Mac on macOS 26 with iPhone Live Activities turned on, and Full Disk Access for the bridgething desktop app.

data.label: Open automatically
data.description: Bring Live Activities to the front when a new activity starts, and go back to the previous app when the last one ends.
